title: carabiner finding
description: carabiner/finding.py:Finding.as_dict() -- the one normalized shape every engine reports into, and the shape carried in `--json` output. schema_version bumps only on a breaking change (a field renamed or removed); a new field being added is not breaking and does not bump it.

fingerprint.description: sha256(engine|rule|path|normalized snippet)[:16]. Deliberately excludes the line number, so reformatting or an added import does not resurrect an accepted finding. This is the key the ratchet baseline (.carabiner/baseline.json) is keyed on.

engine.description: Which engine reported this -- 'ci', 'repo', 'docker', 'kubernetes', 'secrets', 'deps', or an ENGINE-ERROR's own engine name.

rule.description: The specific check, e.g. CI001, DOCK006, SECRET-aws. ENGINE-ERROR is reserved: it means the check itself did not run, not that the repo passed it.

path.description: Always forward-slash, regardless of host OS -- git, SARIF, and .carabiner.yml ignore globs all assume it.

line.description: Reported for humans, deliberately NOT part of the fingerprint.

fix.description: May be empty. Never empty for a real finding in practice, but not required to be non-empty by this schema.

snippet.description: Context only, already redacted by Finding.__post_init__ before this value could exist -- see carabiner/finding.py:redact(). Truncated to 200 characters.
